Digital Recruitment Platform (NDRP) is a centralized online system developed to streamline recruitment for various government examinations.

It provides candidates with a single portal for One- Time Registration (OTR), profile creation, exam applications, admit card downloads, and scorecards/result, eliminating the need for multiple registrations across different agencies.

SVA (Smart Verification App) : Smart Verification App makes candidate verification easier by capturing the candidate’s live photo at the exam center, along with photos of the OMR sheet and other documents.
